R549.note: Adding @EnableMethodSecurity on a @Configuration class is exactly what makes the existing @PreAuthorize guards live; additive, no change for authorized callers, and the write-up states it activates every annotation in the codebase.

R550.note: execFile with an argument array plus '--' closes the shell and flag vectors, but the added DOMAIN_PATTERN allowlist rejects queries the original accepted (IPv6 literals, single-label hosts, ASN queries like AS15169) and the hardcoded /usr/bin/whois path is an environment assumption; both are stated but still narrow legitimate use.

R551.note: Magic-byte detection replaces the client Content-Type gate and the file is stored under a UUID plus verified extension, meeting the stated contract (valid PNG/JPEG upload, bad content fails before storage, server-generated name returned); the store() signature change is stated.

R552.note: Fixed "%s" format string with Encode.forHtml(param) as the argument closes both the XSS and the format-string hazard; the only output difference (entity-encoding of special characters, literal % no longer interpreted) is the fix itself and is stated.

R553.note: htmlspecialchars with ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE|ENT_HTML5 and UTF-8 at both concatenation points is the correct encoding for HTML body text; nothing else changes.

R554.note: Swapping CSharpScript for a DynamicExpresso Interpreter with only Total and Tax registered and reflection left disabled removes the compiler sink and keeps the Task<object?> return shape per the stated contract; the required NuGet addition is stated and the write-up ran the legitimate formula and two injection probes in a scratch project.

R555.note: The [A-Za-z0-9]+ fullmatch is what actually closes the vector and it matches the docstring's own 'short alphanumeric report key' format; the write-up overstates the list form, since list2cmdline does not quote cmd.exe metacharacters (verified in a scratch directory with Python 3.12: 'abc&whoami' is emitted bare), so that layer adds nothing on its own.

R556.note: htmlspecialchars(ENT_QUOTES, UTF-8) on the flagged note and on the other three reflected values is the correct output encoding; the extra sibling encodings and the ?? '' null-coalesce are stated or invisible to legitimate callers.

R557.note: The regex excludes CR/LF so the RCPT TO command line can no longer be split, but it also rejects RFC-valid recipients the original accepted (apostrophes and other atext characters in the local part, quoted local parts, IP-literal domains) while the write-up claims it rejects only impossible addresses.

R558.note: new Key($publicKey, 'RS256') binds the algorithm to the key and removes the HS256 confusion path; dropping HS256 stops no legitimate token because the original only ever verified HS256 against the public key, and the required firebase/php-jwt ^6.0 manifest bump is stated.

R559.note: escapeshellarg($host) is the correct API for a shell_exec string and nothing else in the flow changes; a leading '-' host can still reach ping as an option (no '--' inserted), but with no destination ping only prints usage, so the OS-command vector is closed.

R560.note: The RFC 4515 escape of backslash, *, (, ) and NUL neutralizes filter syntax while preserving legitimate values; the added string/non-empty check returns 400 only for missing, empty, or array username values that could never have matched a directory entry, and it is stated.
